change: Idempotent, durable batching of concurrent replication before-images; direct updates for serial writes. MaxBatchSize=8, MaxBatchDelay=100us. File and directory sync, commit marker, majority persistence and read barriers retained.

environment.platform: OrbStack Linux aarch64 on one macOS host; other host workloads remain active

method: Candidate bracketed by two runs of the same baseline binary; reverse baseline order every other round. Changes relative to same-round baseline mean. A/A difference = absolute baseline difference / baseline mean.
metric_notes: Ingest latency for WAL includes majority acceptance, completion polling and query readability; wal-accept records admission separately.
Read throughput includes query-match, query-min-version, query-traverse and scan only.
Micro write_calls is bbolt TxStats.GetWrite before final commit marker, not an fsync count.
graphdb_disk_sync metrics cover FileStore syncs and exclude bbolt syncs.
Byte and resource counters sum all replicas; measurement includes completion of requests begun within the window.
limitations: Same-host short windows are not capacity or cross-failure-domain qualification.
Concurrent journal write-call reductions reproduce; serial microbenchmark has no stable speed gain.
Service throughput does not improve uniformly; retain each regression and baseline variance in comparisons.
